description: Convert Swiss gross monthly salary to estimated net salary after employee social contributions (AVS/AI/APG 5.3% uncapped, AC 1.1% up to 148,200/year, LPP employee share by age when age is given). Income tax and LAMal health insurance are not withheld. Same engine as /api/v1/salaire-net?pays=ch. Returns: {gross_monthly, avs_ai_apg_5_3pct, ac_chomage_1_1pct, lpp_2e_pilier_10pct (LPP employee share, CHF/month), lamal_health_fixed (0), net_monthly, ...}. See list_bundles for related 'finance-suisse' calculators.

age.description: Optional age: adds the LPP employee contribution (ages 25-65); omitted = LPP not included

name: calculate_swiss_salary

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").
